biotools.summary: DMRdb is a disease-centric Mendelian randomization database that systematically assesses causal relationships between diseases and genes, proteins, CpG sites, metabolites, and other diseases. The database aggregates high-quality disease GWAS data and results from MR analyses, providing a valuable resource for advancing understanding of disease mechanisms and identifying potential therapeutic targets.
